_comment: Compiler flags of the retail build, per source file, for the matching compiler
(tools/mcc.py: SCE ee-gcc 2.9-ee-991111b, the -divs copy). The first rule whose
glob matches applies. -ffast-math: the original has max.s / min.s in clamps and
sqrt.s without sqrtf's errno call. Per-file rules come from tools/tuneflags.py
(measured: the flags under which the file scores best) or from evidence in

rules.evidence: collect2's generated constructor-table file, compiled by collect2 itself without the link's -O/-G options: reg_frame / dereg_frame have unoptimised $fp frames (sd $fp; daddu $fp,$sp; ...; daddu $sp,$fp), as the bootstrap's src/crtbegin.c (its rule: -O0). -O2 scores 0/2 (15.8%), -O0 2/2 exact with data (ref/matching/u000/notes.md)
